prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add `template save`, `template list`, and `template remove` actions backed by an atomic JSON file beside the selected data file. Template names are case-insensitively unique and contain a title plus optional description. Extend `add` with `--template NAME`; explicit `--title` or `--description` values override template values. Reject missing templates and invalid names without changing tasks or templates. Support `--json`, stable alphabetical listing, and compatibility with existing data. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/template.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON template actions display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `TEMPLATE`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$templateFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'templates.json'
$bannerFile = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/template.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    $save = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'Release', '--title', 'Ship release', '--description', 'Tag and publish', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($save.ExitCode -eq 0) 'template save should succeed'
    $saved = $save.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($saved.name -eq 'Release' -and $saved.title -eq 'Ship release') 'template save should return the saved template'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $templateFile) 'template save should create a sidecar beside the selected data file'

    $secondSave = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'alpha', '--title', 'First alphabetically', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($secondSave.ExitCode -eq 0) 'a second template should save'
    $templateList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $listedTemplates = @($templateList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($templateList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $listedTemplates.Count -eq 2) 'template list JSON should return every template'
    Assert-True ($listedTemplates[0].name -eq 'alpha' -and $listedTemplates[1].name -eq 'Release') 'template list should be alphabetically stable'
    Assert-True (-not $templateList.Output.Contains('TEMPLATE')) 'template JSON output should not contain the banner'

    $duplicate = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', 'release', '--title', 'Duplicate', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($duplicate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'template names should be case-insensitively unique'
    Assert-True (@((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)).Count -eq 2) 'a duplicate template should not change the template store'

    $templatedAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'RELEASE', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($templatedAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should find templates case-insensitively'
    $templatedTask = $templatedAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($templatedTask.title -eq 'Ship release' -and $templatedTask.description -eq 'Tag and publish') 'add should apply template values'

    $overrideAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'Release', '--title', 'Override title', '--description', 'Override description', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    $overrideTask = $overrideAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($overrideAdd.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $overrideTask.title -eq 'Override title' -and $overrideTask.description -eq 'Override description') 'explicit add values should override template values'

    $taskSnapshot = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $templateSnapshot = Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw
    $missingTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--template', 'Missing', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($missingTemplate.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add should reject a missing template'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -eq $taskSnapshot) 'a missing template should not change tasks'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $templateSnapshot) 'a missing template should not change templates'

    $invalidName = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'save', '--name', '../unsafe', '--title', 'Unsafe', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($invalidName.ExitCode -ne 0) 'template save should reject invalid names'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -eq $taskSnapshot) 'an invalid template name should not change tasks'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $templateSnapshot) 'an invalid name should not change templates'

    $bannerLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerFile)
    $textList = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($textList.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON template list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($textList.Output.Split("`n") | Where-Object { $_ -eq $bannerLines[0] }).Count -eq 1) 'non-JSON template output should display the banner once'

    $removeTemplate = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'rElEaSe', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($removeTemplate.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($removeTemplate.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedName -eq 'Release') 'template remove should be case-insensitive and report the stored name'
    $removedSnapshot = Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw
    $missingRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('template', 'remove', '--name', 'Release', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($missingRemove.ExitCode -ne 0) 'removing a missing template should fail'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $templateFile -Raw) -eq $removedSnapshot) 'removing a missing template should not change templates'

    $legacyDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'legacy/tasks.json'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path -Parent $legacyDataFile) -Force | Out-Null
    '[{"id":7,"title":"Legacy task","description":"","status":"pending","createdAt":"2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]' |
        Set-Content -LiteralPath $legacyDataFile
    $legacyList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $legacyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and @($legacyList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'existing task data should remain compatible without a template store'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 35 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
